Medical Aesthetics and Laser is more than a medispa - it’s a place where advanced science, innovation, and compassionate care come together. Our passionate team of nurses, nurse practitioners, and aestheticians is dedicated to staying at the forefront of medical aesthetic technology and techniques. With years of experience and ongoing training, we deliver treatments that are safe, effective, and designed to enhance your natural beauty. We know that navigating skin and wellness concerns can feel overwhelming, which is why we make the process simple and approachable. From your first visit, you’ll feel welcomed, cared for, and heard. We offer complimentary consultations to help you understand your options and create a customized plan - whether through our wide range of aesthetic services or medical-grade skincare. At Meg & Co., our goal is simple: to help you look and feel radiant, confident, and completely at home in your skin. The Meg & Co.
